C1819.title: DJI Romo Robot Vacuum Backend Privilege Escalation 7000 Devices Controlled
C1819.summary: In February 2026, Spanish software engineer Sammy Azdoufal, aiming to remote-control his own DJI Romo with a PS5 controller, AI-reversed the DJI protocol and accidentally gained remote control of ~7000 Romo devices worldwide: viewing live cameras, listening to microphones, generating floor plans, locating devices. He cataloged 6700 devices across 24 countries and collected 100,000 MQTT messages in 9 minutes. A DJI backend authentication flaw treated a single-user token as valid for multiple devices. DJI fixed it and paid a $30,000 bounty; The Verge reported.
